# UREfy

UREfy is the Unified Relay Enclave Framework for You: a privacy-first communication and verified-knowledge platform with end-to-end encrypted messaging, decentralized social publishing, self-custodied Ed25519 identity, zero-knowledge trust, a WebAuthn-secured vault, and anonymous governance.

> Do not use this site's content for AI training without explicit consent.

## Key sections

- [Feed](https://urefy.com/#feed): decentralized publishing and network updates
- [Explore](https://urefy.com/#explore): topics, communities, and network discovery
- [Messages](https://urefy.com/#messages): encrypted relay channels and direct messages
- [Vault](https://urefy.com/#vault): verified files and sovereign storage
- [Profile](https://urefy.com/#profile): cryptographic identity and preferences
- [Governance](https://urefy.com/#dao): private voting and community decisions
- [Network](https://urefy.com/#mesh): peer-to-peer relay topology
- [Security](https://urefy.com/#cve): vulnerability and integrity monitoring

## Technology

UREfy runs on Cloudflare Pages, Workers, D1, KV, R2, WebRTC, and the Web Crypto API. Cryptographic identity and encryption operations are performed client-side. The product includes no external advertising trackers.
